text:
- Use the arm named in the instruction; if none, use the arm on the bottle’s side. Grasp the bottle body top-down at body centre.
- Lift to 20-25 cm; verify the lift result shows gripper_z in that range before shaking.
- Shake horizontally with at least five alternating dx moves (±8-10 cm if accepted); keep dy=0 and dz=0.
- If a dx move returns PLAN_FAIL, retry with smaller alternating dx (2-3 cm); do not use dy/dz or re-grasp.
- Even if the sentence says to release or put it down, end still holding it raised after the shaking.
- Before done, verify checks pass: [["holding", arm, "bottle"], ["height", "bottle", 15]], and that the alternating dx moves succeeded.
goal: Bottle held by chosen arm, bottom above 15 cm, after horizontal shaking.
